```sql
WITH county_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Oakland County'
    AND border_type = 'county'
    AND addr_state = 'MI'
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(rast, geometry::geometry, true) AS clipped_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us,
    county_geom
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(rast, geometry::geometry)
),
county_elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ValueCount(clipped_rast, true) AS elevation_stats
  FROM
    dem_clip
),
mean_elevation AS (
  SELECT
    (elevation_stats).sum / (elevation_stats).count AS mean_elev
  FROM
    county_elevation_stats
),
poi_above_mean AS (
  SELECT
    '112 Pizzeria Bistro'::text AS poi_name,
    '112 Pizzeria Bistro, Rochester Hills, MI'::text AS display_name
  FROM
    mean_elevation,
    LATERAL ST_Value(public.dem_us.rast, ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.200344 42.641697)'), 4326)::geometry) AS elev
  WHERE
    elev > mean_elev
)
SELECT * FROM poi_above_mean;
```
